title: Wick Liquor Castaway 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Castaway is a vibrant celebration of exotic fruit. It blends prickly pineapple with mashed mango and punchy passionfruit to create a sun-drenched tropical cocktail. Juicy, sweet, and tangy, it is a perfect all-day vape for those who dream of the beach. Supplied in a 120ml bottle, this 100ml shortfill leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Mixed with a High-VG 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, this e-liquid is optimised for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and delivering the depth of flavour Wick Liquor is famous for. Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand from Staffordshire, renowned for their unique "big block" approach to flavour and complex, layered blends.
